notes.title: Celebrate Valentine's Day with Tank De La Muerta's final episode
notes.content:
It  is finally over. The gang joins up to lament the day they have and start fighting each other. However, Sofía and Enrique arrive at the nick of time to stop them.

https://youtu.be/2UNyGDNZqFk

notes.title: Tank De La Muerta Episode 4 released today!
notes.content:
Not knowing how to deal with Enrique's secret, Juan goes to the wise Zoe for advice. She has many things to say! However, they're both interrupted by Clara and the conversation takes on a different direction.

A new episode each Wednesday up until the game's release.

notes.title: Tank De La Muerta Episode 1 now available
notes.content:
Greetings,

To tease our upcoming game, we have created a 6-episode-long Mexican novella, serving as a prelude for it.

The story follows Sofía (a Tank) and Enrique (a Zombie) as they try to figure out how to make their love work.

A new episode each Wednesday up until the game's release.


https://youtu.be/vCevmkUF6jA
